rca of the issue: Original bug: in Multi-Part Matched Set Per-Job freight, only jobFreightCost (a flat single value) was sent to the engine and used for ALL set-qty slots — so slots[].freightLine, the per-component allocation, and the right-rail card all showed the first tier's freight in every tier. Fix verified: (a) frontend useEngine.buildMpPayload now sends jobFreightBySlot map, (b) backend engine_routes.py Per-Job slot branch reads jobFreightBySlot[str(slot)] (with jobFreightCost fallback) for both line freight and the MSF-weighted per-component allocation, (c) RightDashboard.jsx Per-Job card reads s.jobFreightBySlot[selSlot] and exposes data-testid 'freight-per-job-qty', (d) PreviewPdfModal MatchedSetPricingGrid Freight row reads slots[].freightLine. Live UI now shows the three distinct, increasing per-tier values ($185.79 / $230.64 / $299.89) consistently across Quote Table, right-rail card, and PDF grid.
